## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
- Documentation of the new mechanism, config keys, and known limitations (cross-file context loss via chunking, partial mitigation via aggregator).

## Implementation Notes
Update `plugins/dso/docs/CI-INTEGRATION.md` AND `plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md`:

**CI-INTEGRATION.md**:
- New section: 'Large-diff fallback pipeline'
- Document the flow: filter \xe2\x86\x92 threshold check \xe2\x86\x92 chunk (Strategy E + F) \xe2\x86\x92 dispatch \xe2\x86\x92 aggregate \xe2\x86\x92 emit.
- Document OVER_BOUND status: when it fires, what it means for the operator, how /dso:fp-recovery rejects it.
- Document the visibility trailer namespace (DSO-Review-Coverage:) and why it must NOT collide with DSO-Story-Merge:.
- Known limitations section: file-level chunking strips cross-file context; aggregator partially mitigates but cannot fully restore.

**CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md**:
- New section: review.large_diff.*
- Document keys: threshold_lines, max_files, max_calls, ignore.glob (with non-empty defaults), ignore.regex.
- Document validation behavior on zero values.

Doc-router Gate 2 fired (existing reference docs). Emit DOC_ROUTER_ATTESTATION at commit.

| Source file | Action | Tests | Class |
|---|---|---|---|
| `plugins/dso/docs/CI-INTEGRATION.md` | modify | n/a (instruction) | still-valid |
| `plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md` | modify | n/a (instruction) | still-valid |

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] CI-INTEGRATION.md covers large-diff pipeline
  Verify: grep -qE 'large.diff|OVER_BOUND|visibility.trailer' plugins/dso/docs/CI-INTEGRATION.md
- [ ] CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md covers review.large_diff.* keys
  Verify: grep -qE 'review\\.large_diff|max_files|max_calls|ignore\\.glob' plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md
- [ ] Visibility trailer namespace documented
  Verify: grep -q 'DSO-Review-Coverage' plugins/dso/docs/CI-INTEGRATION.md

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet); escalate.
